text: Hourglass indexes its whole market with Envio HyperIndex, deployed on Envio Cloud and synced live with Monad testnet.
One GraphQL query returns what would take thousands of RPC calls: protocol totals, provider reliability, and the average time to machine.
Every oracle check is indexed per lease, and each GPU-hour token is registered dynamically from the factory event.
The app reads it live. The providers page shows network stats and each provider's onchain track record, straight from the indexer.
And the market dashboard charts hours sold and volume over time, from the same index.
